scene: The boardwalk leads to a bustling transit plaza. Where do you travel?
picture: On a wide stone plaza, the player in her yellow raincoat and green boots stands in the centre, red umbrella in hand. On the left waits a yellow street tram with open doors. Up high hangs a glass cable car at its platform. On the right, glowing subway stairs lead underground.
shown: a sleek yellow street tram with open doors on the left
a glass cable car suspended from a wire up high
an illuminated subway entrance with tiled stairs on the right
